description: Election Commission  -  Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1841/33, Kesbewa  D/S Division, and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific details about parcels of land, including their numbers, block numbers, cadastral map references, locations, and amendments to title particulars such as servitude rights, ownership status changes, and land use designations. The content is entirely focused on land and property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
